issue_context.title: Refine the implement of warning handle of column type change
issue_context.body:
## Development Task
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17380469/95570555-add95280-0a59-11eb-9f1a-aeabf7238663.png)
As we can see from the picture,  before the change, we get an error instead of a warning in alterStmt.
This confuses us. We need to make it as warnings instead of errors.
After fixing it, we can simplify the logic in reorgCtx.
Besides, we should set the session variables according to the SQL mode.

review_comments: We don't need to pull put the warnings here. We can merge warnings per worker, not per row.

that's not good, 
1: cause warnings computed here is not what should be merged into the job. eg: you add 512 warnings here, while only half of them committed successfully, half of them should be abandoned. 
2: fetch the real warnings after each kv txn committed is the right way. so as added count does.
